messages:
ana_runtime: heads up — preflight for runtime/quant-package v4.2.1 on eu-canary failed, deploybot aborted. checksum mismatch when unpacking the bundle.

deploy-bot: :warning: deploybot aborted preflight on eu-canary for artifact runtime-quant-v4.2.1 (build 20260315-#245). expected sha256=abc123...ef, got sha256=def456...12. No traffic promoted.

sam_ops: copying — can we pin eu region to previous runtime image until this is sorted? prefer a short TTL pin.

ana_runtime: yes please pin, we don't want the canary to flip. sam_ops can you request pin with deploybot? TTL 2h unless we get a hotfix.

sam_ops: @deploy-bot pin-image region=eu image=runtime-quant-v4.2.0 reason="canary checksum abort" ttl=2h

deploy-bot: ack — pin created: eu -> runtime-quant-v4.2.0 (ttl 2h). will auto-unpin at 6791242070 unless extended.

jin_prod: what produced the bad checksum — packaging or CI artifact mismatch? any idea if it's a flake or malicious?

ana_runtime: initial triage: packaging job uploaded a .tar.gz with correct digest in CI, but reality on the storage node was different. suspect S3 eventual-consistency or a staging replication glitch. not seeing signs of tampering.

sam_ops: can packaging re-upload and we re-run preflight? who owns the upload step? @maria_docs who should I ping in packaging?

maria_docs: packaging is Nora and team; ping @nora_pack. also will update the release notes draft to note a temporary pin and that we aborted eu canary preflight.

ops_oncall: request: after new artifact is uploaded, run these checks before unpin: `sha256sum model_bundle.tar.gz` and compare with CI artifact; then run a quick smoke: `./tools/smoke-test --region eu --artifact 20260315-#245` (5m). post the smoke exit code.

ana_runtime: agreed. if smoke passes, we do a staged unpin and re-run canary at 10% for 30m then promote. if smoke fails we keep pin and escalate to packaging for full artifact sweep.

sam_ops: @nora_pack can you re-publish artifact and confirm checksums? link to CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/c/245/artifacts/runtime-quant-v4.2.1.tar.gz

nora_pack (via sam_ops): i'll re-upload now and attach the sha256. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: system note — there is a nighttime maintenance window scheduled in eu at 02:00 local (6791270000). if we don't resolve before then, we should keep the pin across the maintenance. confirm ops plan.

jin_prod: keep the pin. don't let auto-unpin run during maintenance. can we extend TTL to cover the window?

sam_ops: extending TTL to cover window: @deploy-bot extend-pin eu until 6791283600 reason="cover maintenance window and re-upload"

deploy-bot: ack — pin extended: eu -> runtime-quant-v4.2.0 until 6791283600.

maria_docs: updating release notes: will add bullet — "eu canary rollout paused due to artifact checksum mismatch; pin to v4.2.0 enacted. investigating packaging re-upload." putting a quick blurb in the internal release notes doc.

ops_oncall: once packaging confirms, I'll run smoke and post logs. quick checklist for whoever runs it: 1) verify sha256 locally matches CI 2) run smoke 3) confirm memory/oom telemetry looks normal for 10m.

ana_runtime: thumbs up. also leaving a note: if we see repeated checksum mismatches across regions, we enable an emergency gating rule: `preflight.strict_storage=true` which will require integrity check on upload. not flipping it now.

sam_ops: thanks all. i'll keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:

nora_pack: re-upload complete. sha256=abc123...ef (matches CI). artifact URL: https://storage.redwood/obj/runtime-quant-v4.2.1/20260315-#245.tar.gz

ops_oncall: running verify now. `sha256sum runtime-quant-v4.2.1.tar.gz` -> abc123...ef. smoke starting.

ops_oncall: smoke finished: exit 0. no OOMs in initial 10m. attaching tail of smoke log: ```smoke: ok, 200/200 responses, p95=110ms, mem_rss=5.2GB```

ana_runtime: excellent. plan: unpin, staged canary 10% 30m, monitor latency/memory and error-rate. if any regression trigger immediate pin back to v4.2.0 and abort. sam_ops can you execute unpin when ready?

sam_ops: @deploy-bot unpin eu reason="artifact verified, smoke ok — staged canary"

deploy-bot: unpin acknowledged. initiating staged canary: 10% traffic to runtime-quant-v4.2.1 on eu for 30m. will post metrics snapshot at t+15m.

maria_docs: updated release notes and internal incident blurb. will add a short remediation note for packaging.

jin_prod: watching metrics. if p99 or error-rate climbs >1.5x baseline, we roll back.

ana_runtime: thanks everyone. keeping channel open for final decision at end of canary.

sam_ops: noted — will escalate immediately if deploy-bot posts any abort.
